title: Data Analyst - Customer Success
description:
Our Global SaaS client is now seeking an experienced Data Analyst to join their Global Customer Success Data Science Team for a 9-month contract.

You’ll play a pivotal role in improving how they measure and deliver customer success, driving impact across Customer Experience, Digital Experience, Service Delivery, and Supportability. You will partner closely with cross-functional teams, and ensure that data informs strategy, enhances customer journeys, and scales operational excellence.

Key Responsibilities

  • Building robust data foundations: Collaborate with engineering to develop pipelines, improve data integrity, and establish clear metric definitions and governance tailored for international markets.
  • Developing actionable dashboards & reporting: Create and maintain scalable, user-friendly dashboards that provide visibility into key performance metrics and think broadly across the end-to-end customer journey.
  • Delivering deep-dive analytics: Conduct root cause analysis to uncover drivers of customer pain points, digital adoption challenges, and operational inefficiencies and translate findings into actionable recommendations that improve customer journeys.
  • Advancing AI-native analytics: Leverage Gen AI tools to automate recurring insight generation, support AI-powered summarization and anomaly detection, and identify opportunities to replace manual workflows with intelligent automation — helping the team move faster and deliver more scalable, proactive insights.
  • Enabling experimentation & continuous improvement: Support A/B testing and digital experience evaluations by analysing performance outcomes and quantifying customer and business impact.
  • Influencing strategy through storytelling: Communicate insights and trends clearly and persuasively to technical and non-technical stakeholders, ensuring alignment on decisions that improve customer experience, digital adoption, operational performance, and supportability.

Skills

  • 8+ years of experience in Data Analytics or Data Science, ideally with exposure to Customer Success, Operations, or Digital Experience domains
  • Proficiency in SQL for data extraction, transformation, and pipeline development
  • Experience with dashboarding and visualization tools (Tableau, Qlik, or similar)
  • Familiarity with big data tools (Snowflake, Databricks, Spark) and ETL processes
  • Experience with Python or R for advanced analytics, automation, or experimentation support preferred
  • Knowledge of statistical methods and experimentation (A/B testing) preferred
  • Machine learning and Generative AI experience is a plus
  • A genuine enthusiasm for Gen AI and a growth mindset toward how emerging tools can accelerate analytical work
  • Proven ability to communicate analytical findings in clear, actionable narratives for both technical and non-technical audiences

Benefits

  • Award winning work environment
  • Hybrid working
  • Long contract with potential to extend
